references.text: The same introduction 'Hear, O Israel' that calls God's people to attention
A similar call for Israel to listen before entering the land
Describes the crossing of the Jordan to take possession of the land
The fulfillment of crossing the Jordan River
Describes the great and fortified cities in Canaan
The same description of cities that are great and fortified up to heaven
Describes the nations that are greater and more powerful than Israel
God's promise to drive out nations that are greater and more powerful
The promise to take possession of land from nations that are greater and more powerful
